_about: Building visuals. `glb` (res:// path) is the hand-built Blender structure set (tools/blender/structures, one shared 1024 atlas) and wins when present; `aabb_m` is its measured size in Godot axes (x, y up, z) for colliders; `stages` lists per-stage GLBs for processing stations. `model` is the old Kenney Survival Kit 2.0 (CC0) name under res://assets/props/kenney/<name>.glb, kept as the fallback; rows whose art_status is REPLACE are marked for replacement (docs/orchestration/mmo/asset-replacement.md): Kenney rows, and the Blender building-system stand-ins. Every Blender row carries `upgrade`, its low-poly upgrade path. Footprints are grid cells (1 m). model_sizes_m are the Kenney sizes (Blender x, y, z=up). `farm` holds the farm kit models (dsc farmkit: field plots, crop stages, path tiles and farm props). They are not placeable building kinds; the game picks them up by name.
